title: Avatar: Seven Havens Creators Clarify Metalbending and Lavabending
excerpt:
The producers say both bending disciplines still exist in the future setting.
Metalbending has become rarer, but appearances in Season 2 are not guaranteed.
body_md:
Following the first season of Avatar: Seven Havens, fans have questioned what happened to specialized bending techniques familiar from earlier Avatar stories. The new series takes place more than two centuries after The Legend of Korra, leaving plenty of room for the world's practices and traditions to change.

During a Reddit question-and-answer session, producers Ethan Spaulding and Sehaj Sethi confirmed that lavabending has not disappeared. They also explained that metalbending survives after the cataclysm in the story, although it is considerably rarer than it was in previous eras.

These comments establish that the abilities remain possible within the fictional world; they do not promise that either technique will be shown in the next season. The producers have not specified which characters might eventually demonstrate them.

According to the reported schedule, Season 2 is planned to begin on Paramount+ on May 21, 2027, with 13 episodes. Another 13-episode season is expected later in 2027, and the overall series is intended to conclude with a fourth season.
